Class PhysicalReplayContext

java.lang.Object
com.viaversion.viafabricplus.bedrock.movement.replay.PhysicalReplayContext
public final class PhysicalReplayContext extends Object
Historical physics runs on the client thread. Other threads retain normal network and world behavior.
